answer: Producing 47 answers an epoch therefore costs 70 real forward passes, and the yarrow record lets any auditor recompute the check. Replaying a stored transcript fails because the challenge words differ every epoch, and fabricating a commitment fails a crystal spot-check that re-runs the prompt. Each answer is accompanied by a commitment to the inference that produced it: a model fingerprint plus a hash of the token logits, posted as a tide header. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
